ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a phylogenetic tree with the root on the left and species names on the right. On the right, from top to bottom, B. physalus, B. edeni, B. boreales, B. brydei, B. musculus, Megaptera Novaeangliae, and Eschrichtius robustus are labeled in order. The upper branch of the tree contains B. physalus, B. edeni, B. boreales, and B. brydei, among which B. boreales and B. brydei are located on the same closer small branch. The lower branch of the tree contains B. musculus, Megaptera Novaeangliae, and Eschrichtius robustus. Reasoning: To judge how close or distant relationships are, one must look at the position of the most recent common ancestor of two species; the closer the most recent common ancestor is to the root of the tree, the more distant the relationship is. Species within the same small branch, such as B. boreales and B. brydei, have a closer most recent common ancestor, so their relationship is closer. B. brydei is located within the upper Balaenoptera branch, while B. musculus is located in the lower branch; they must trace back to a branching point closer to the root before they have a common ancestor, so compared with species within the same small branch, their relationship is more distant. According to the relationships given in the figure, the most distant pair is B. musculus and B. brydei.

raw_record.question_text: Scientists used embryology, morphology, paleontology, and molecular biology to create the phylogenetic tree below. According to the phylogenetic tree, which pair of species is the most distantly related?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是一棵左侧为根、右侧为物种名称的系统发育树，包含 B. physalus、B. edeni、B. boreales、B. brydei、B. musculus、Megaptera novaeangliae 和 Eschrichtius robustus。然后根据题干要求寻找“亲缘关系最远”的一对。对候选物种在树上的位置逐一比较它们的最近共同祖先：若两物种在同一小分支内，如 B. boreales 与 B. brydei，则亲缘较近；若一者在上方 Balaenoptera 分支、另一者在下方分支，则共同祖先更靠近根，亲缘更远。图中 B. brydei 位于上方分支，而 B. musculus 位于下方分支，它们的连接点比同一小分支内的物种更靠近根，因此选 B. musculus and B. brydei。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一棵左侧为根、右侧为物种名称的系统发育树。右侧从上到下依次标出 B. physalus、B. edeni、B. boreales、B. brydei、B. musculus、Megaptera Novaeangliae 和 Eschrichtius robustus。树的上方分支包含 B. physalus、B. edeni、B. boreales 和 B. brydei，其中 B. boreales 与 B. brydei 位于同一个较近的小分支上。树的下方分支包含 B. musculus、Megaptera Novaeangliae 和 Eschrichtius robustus。推理：判断亲缘关系远近要看两个物种的最近共同祖先位置；最近共同祖先越靠近树根，亲缘关系越远。同一小分支内的物种，如 B. boreales 与 B. brydei，最近共同祖先较近，因此亲缘较近。B. brydei 位于上方 Balaenoptera 分支内，而 B. musculus 位于下方分支，它们要回溯到更靠近根部的分叉点才有共同祖先，因此相比同一小分支内的物种亲缘更远。根据图中给出的关系，最远的一对是 B. musculus 和 B. brydei。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer names the same pair of species as the standard answer: B. musculus and B. brydei.

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct topology/MRCA route: it solves by locating the candidate species on opposite major branches of the tree and choosing the pair whose most recent common ancestor is closest to the root.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the phylogenetic tree labels and branching pattern: B. brydei is in the upper Balaenoptera clade with B. boreales/B. edeni/B. physalus, while B. musculus lies on a lower branch grouped nearer Megaptera novaeangliae and Eschrichtius robustus rather than with the B. brydei subclade.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read that the problem asks, in Chinese, which pair of species is most distantly related according to the displayed phylogenetic tree.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the phylogenetic-tree rule that the most distantly related pair has the oldest most recent common ancestor, i.e., their branches meet nearest the root; branch-tip spacing or visual distance across the page should not be used unless the tree gives a scale.
